newsitem.title: UK: NWE bunkers firm in active market, Med flat.
newsitem.headline: NWE bunkers firm in active market, Med flat.

text.p: Bunker oil prices in northwest Europe were steady on Wednesday with demand down from earlier in the week, dealers said.
They put volume in ARA at a moderate 20,000 tonnes.
Rotterdam 380 cst fuel oil was unchanged at $86/$87 a tonne fob, with 180 cst at $92/94. Antwerp prices were at about the same level.
"Trade is pretty flat," one dealer said.
Business in the Mediterranean was also lacklustre, with 380 cst at Fos priced at a little changed $89/91 and at $93/94 in Augusta.
Demand in Fujairah was steady with 380 cst little changed at $96/97 for 380 cst and $103/4 for 180 cst.
